description: This file defines the Java interface 'InitializationDatabase' which declares methods for checking if a database is empty and for populating the database with a specified name, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: InitializationDatabase
classes.description: Java interface providing methods for database initialization and verification within the reference initialization service package.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the database is empty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the database with the specified name, may throw a ServiceException.
